data.gender_notes: Alinaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Alinaa is derived from the Arabic root 'Ali', meaning exalted or noble. It signifies a person of high moral character and nobility. The name Alinaa carries the meaning “Noble, Exalted, Noble-born” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Alinaa usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, exalted, noble-born and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Alinaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, Exalted, Noble-born.”
